label: Beurre d'Échiré
note: AOP Charentes-Poitou; made by the Échiré dairy cooperative since 1894 from milk of farms within about 50 km; AOP rules reportedly demand 18 h cream maturation and pH 4.7 (standard rules 12 h, pH 6) – the figures come from a French press article seen only in search summaries

about.text: Butter from cream matured with lactic ferments for 18 hours and churned in wooden churns by the Échiré cooperative in Deux-Sèvres; AOP Charentes-Poitou.
